items.note: A teal band floods the header with an ink 'Overview' h1 and a single pink Refresh lift button, followed by four outlined stat cards, an ink bar chart with a small pink coin sticker at 32px, an activity list, then a 1px ink rule over pill filters and a bordered table with 2px row-action arrow buttons. This matches the dashboard row of the spec. The chart card is shorter than the activity card beside it, which leaves a block of empty paper under the chart.

The ink-filled current-page pill strip sits above the search field. The teal band collapses to the title, the meta line and the pink Refresh button, and the stat cards, chart and activity list stack in one column with even spacing. The projects table scrolls inside its box, and at this width only Project and Owner show, with the status pills cut at the right edge.

Black ground with charcoal raised cards, the same teal band with ink text and the pink Refresh button, white chart bars and a paper-filled current nav pill. This follows the spec's dark mapping and the reference's dark storefront, where charcoal tiles sit on black under one loud accent.

The dark stack mirrors the light one: a paper-filled 'Overview' pill, the teal band with ink title and pink button, and charcoal stat and activity cards with readable secondary text. The table clips Status and every column after it at the right edge, just as it does in light mode.

A yellow section band with an ink h1 and meta line sits over an 'All projects' h2. Next come outlined pill filters with a raised selected 'All' and a filter input, then the bordered table with a grey header, underlined secondary-gray project links, outlined status pills with icons and 2px arrow row actions. The look is dense and flat, in the reference's register.

The 'Projects' pill is ink-filled in the top strip and the yellow band collapses to title and meta. Pills and the filter field sit on one line. The table only shows Project and Owner in full, with status icons sliced at the box edge, so status, budget, due date and the row action are hidden behind a horizontal scroll that has no cue.

The yellow band keeps ink text on the black ground. The charcoal table box has light text, outlined status pills and paper-outlined arrow buttons, and the selected 'All' filter pill is filled raised charcoal. Hierarchy runs band, then h2, then table, and nothing is cramped.
The paper-filled current pill, the yellow band with ink text and the charcoal table all read well in dark mode. The same right-edge cut hides the status column and everything after it.

The detail page keeps the parent's yellow band and holds the breadcrumb, an h1 project title, an owner meta line, a status pill and the pill tabs, with 'Overview' selected and filled raised. Below is one outlined card: a description, then four grey wells, one of which holds a pink budget price tag. It is sparse, but it follows the rule that one band color is shared by a section's parent and child pages.

The band stacks breadcrumb, title, meta, status pill and the tab strip, all in ink on yellow. The overview card wraps its four wells into a 2x2 grid with the pink budget tag, and padding is consistent at 16px gutters.

The yellow band keeps ink text. The selected tab and the status pill are charcoal raised fills with light text, so they stay legible on the band. The overview card is charcoal with darker wells and the pink budget tag, which fits the spec's dark rules.

The collapsed yellow band holds ink breadcrumb, title and meta. The 'Overview' tab is a charcoal selected pill and the status pill is dark. The charcoal card shows a 2x2 grid of wells and nothing is clipped.

A periwinkle band has an ink 'Team' h1 and a count line, over one bordered table. Each row has a square outlined initials avatar, the name, an underlined secondary-gray email, then role, location and a right-aligned project count. It is plain and dense, and this section has its own band color.

The ink 'Team' pill and the collapsed periwinkle band read cleanly. The member table keeps its desktop columns, so only Name fits and Role is cut mid-word ('Engineering M…'), with location and project count off-screen inside the box.

The periwinkle band keeps ink text over the black ground. The charcoal table has light names, gray underlined emails and outlined initials avatars, and the paper-filled current nav pill marks the section.
The band and charcoal table read well in dark mode. Again only the Name column fits, and Role is sliced at the box edge with no sign that the table scrolls.

findings.summary: At mobile width, tables keep every desktop column and scroll inside their box. Only the first one or two columns fit, and the next column is cut mid-word or mid-icon, with no cue that the table scrolls. Status, dates and row actions are hidden.
On the dashboard's desktop grid, the chart card is much shorter than the activity card beside it, which leaves a stranded block of empty paper before the section rule.
